profile.name: GB 55037-2022
profile.governs: GB 55037-2022 General code for fire protection of buildings, clause 10.1.10 (mandatory, in force 2023-06-01); where GB 51309-2018 or GB 50016-2014 give lower floor values for the same places, the general code governs
profile.checked: 2026-11-08 against reproductions of the clause in public design-review and training material (several independent sources agree); not yet against the published code text

places.stairs_front_rooms_refuge: evacuation stairwells and their front rooms or combined front rooms, refuge corridors and their front rooms, refuge floors, refuge rooms, fire-fighting-only passages

measurement.quantity: minimum horizontal illuminance on the floor (not an average)
measurement.route_band_note: routes are checked over the central half of their width, as Chinese design calculations do
measurement.area_border_note: no border is defined: the whole floor of the place

GB_51309_2018.note: fire emergency lighting and evacuation indicating systems: system rules where the general code says nothing (reported, not calculated)
